resolution.note: hook test: lane-model: opus inline or behind a brief pointer file routes krn-lane to opus

title: A lane brief line lane-model: opus does not run the lane on Opus
body:
Evidence 2026-11-16: the S7 lane brief (.krn/runs/lead/briefs/t-1p7dmw9.md) carried 'lane-model: opus' and the Agent call asked for opus, yet PR #1249 says 'Agent: Claude Sonnet 5.5'.
Outcome: a brief with lane-model: opus starts the krn-lane agent on Opus; the PR Agent line names Opus
Proof: a regression test feeds a brief with lane-model: opus to the Agent routing hook and asserts the routed model is opus
